template.name: template_contextbar
template.event:
element("numItems"):SetInt($luaPointer:numCurrentItems()) local numItems = element("numItems"):GetInt() local rootItem = nil local previous = nil
for i=0, numItems-1 do local emptyItem = menu:addTemplateElement("template_barbutton", "", element) emptyItem("SheetName"):SetString($luaPointer:getSheetName()) emptyItem("UpSpriteName"):SetString($luaPointer:getUpSprite()) emptyItem("DownSpriteName"):SetString($luaPointer:getDownSprite())
emptyItem("ButtonImageName"):SetString($luaPointer:getImageForButton(i)) emptyItem("ButtonLabelText"):SetCharString($luaPointer:getLabelForButton(i)) emptyItem("ButtonScale"):SetFloat($luaPointer:getScaleForButton(i)) emptyItem("ButtonPadding"):SetInt($luaPointer:getPaddingForButton(i)) emptyItem("AttachedTemplate"):SetString($luaPointer:getAttachedTemplateForButton(i)) emptyItem("FunctionName"):SetString($luaPointer:getFunctionForButton(i)) emptyItem("OnInitFunction"):SetString($luaPointer:getOnInitForButton(i))
emptyItem("UseDownSprite"):SetInt($luaPointer:useDownSprite()) emptyItem("TextScale"):SetFloat($textScale)
emptyItem:setName("barItem"..i) emptyItem:setParent(element) emptyItem:setRelativeObjectAnchors($luaPointer:getHAnchor(), $luaPointer:getVAnchor())
if (previous == nil) then
emptyItem:setOrientation(lua_sys.MenuOrientation(-200, -200, 4, $luaPointer:getHAnchor(), $luaPointer:getVAnchor())) rootItem = emptyItem
else
emptyItem:setOrientation(lua_sys.MenuOrientation(previous("xOffset"):GetInt(), previous("yOffset"):GetInt(), 4, $luaPointer:getHAnchor(), $luaPointer:getVAnchor()))
end
previous = emptyItem
emptyItem:init() emptyItem:setPositionBroadcast(true)
$luaPointer:setBarElement(i, emptyItem)
end
if(rootItem ~= nil) then
local contextInfo = menu:addTemplateElement("template_contextinfo", "InfoElement", element)
contextInfo("titleScale"):SetFloat(0.6)
contextInfo:setOrientation(lua_sys.MenuOrientation(-600, -600, 2, $luaPointer:getHAnchor(), $luaPointer:getVAnchor())) contextInfo:setRelativeObjectAnchors($luaPointer:getHAnchor(), $luaPointer:getVAnchor())
contextInfo:init() contextInfo:setPositionBroadcast(true)
end
element:DoStoredScript(manager:getOnInitFunction())

for i=0,element("numItems"):GetInt()-1 do element:RemoveElement(element:GetElement("barItem"..i)) end
if(element:GetElement("InfoElement") ~= nil) then element:RemoveElement(element:GetElement("InfoElement")) end
element:DoStoredScript("populate")
